Thank you @andrewlewis for your reply. It will be really helpful if we get some workaround as well.
Adding more info we are using the below IMA SDK version.
com.google.ads.interactivemedia.v3:interactivemedia:3.10.9
No updates yet. I will update here when we have made progress.

issue.title: Exo ImaAdsLoader does not consider media load timeout

repository.name: ExoPlayer
repository.description: This project is deprecated and stale. The latest ExoPlayer code is available in https://github.com/androidx/media

issue.body:
### [REQUIRED] Issue description
When I set the media load time out on the Ima Ads loader, it does not time out when the request for ad media takes longer than the set time out instead it just doesn't load the add and does not throw any error. I am supposed to get an  `AdError.AdErrorCode.VAST_MEDIA_LOAD_TIMEOUT` on the ad error listener that I have attached to the AdsLoader. This is not the case for the VAST_LOAD_TIMEOUT, when I set the same value for the Vast load timeout, I get the `AdError.AdErrorCode.VAST_LOAD_TIMEOUT` correctly.

Here is a snippet of how I set the time out

```
val adsLoader = adsLoader ?: ImaAdsLoader.Builder(context).apply {
                                this.setImaSdkSettings(imaSdkSettings)
                                this.setAdEventListener(imaAdEventListener)
                                this.setMediaLoadTimeoutMs(2000)
                            }.buildForAdTag(Uri.parse(mediaAsset.advertTag)).apply {
                                adsLoader.addAdErrorListener(imaAdErrorListener)
                            }
```

### [REQUIRED] Reproduction steps
1. Set the MediaLoadTimeoutMs on the Exo player's ImaAdsLoader to a very low value, e.g 1000ms
Throttle the request for ads media using a proxy or any other means, I use Charles proxy and delay requests for the following URLs 
1. r1---sn-5hne6ns6.gvt1.com
2. redirector.gvt1.com

The AD media loads for some 8 seconds and then it skips AD without throwing any error.

### [REQUIRED] Link to test content
Sample VAST TAG
"https://pubads.g.doubleclick.net/gampad/ads?sz=640x480&iu=/124319096/external/ad_rule_samples&ciu_szs=300x250&ad_rule=1&impl=s&gdfp_req=1&env=vp&output=vmap&unviewed_position_start=1&cust_params=deployment%3Ddevsite%26sample_ar%3Dpremidpostlongpod&cmsid=496&vid=short_tencue&correlator="

### [REQUIRED] A full bug report captured from the device


### [REQUIRED] Version of ExoPlayer being used
Exo Player Version: 2.11.7
IMA extension version: 2.11.7

### [REQUIRED] Device(s) and version(s) of Android being used
Techno Camom CX Air, Android 7.0
Samsung Galaxy S10 Emulato, Android 10
